subject: PoC deployment fit — post-call recap, deployment-mode questions & proposed trial plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@curetech.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 18:23:00 -0700
Subject: PoC deployment fit — post-call recap, deployment-mode questions & proposed trial plan

Hi Priya (and Ben / Lauren),

Thanks again for a productive call earlier — appreciate the clarity on performance targets and the Security/Privacy constraints. Quick recap and a proposed trail plan so we can align on which deployment mode to pursue for the PoC.

Call highlights (short):
- Business goal: integrate Redwood inference for document ingestion + LLM-assisted triage (latency SLO ~150ms p95 for single-doc queries; throughput ~200 reqs/min peak).
- Security: CureTech will treat outputs as PHI for some workflows; their security team flagged KMS-based key management and isolated networking as potential gating items.
- Current leaning: Product wants Dedicated for throughput predictability; Security is asking about Private VPC for PHI workloads. Hosted API could be used for initial integration/smoke.

Proposed two-track PoC (low friction -> gated progression):
1) Week 0–1: Hosted API smoke integration (no PHI). Goal: confirm API integration, SDKs, and end-to-end latency baseline with your sample corpus.
2) Week 2–5: Dedicated trial (reserved GPU capacity) to validate throughput and p95 latency at scale. We can provision a short-term Dedicated pool and run the same workload cadence.
3) Parallel compliance track (Weeks 0–4): if Security requires PHI on day 1, switch to Private deployment discussion (VPC or on-prem). We'll surface required artifacts (SOC2, encryption at-rest/in-transit details, KMS/HSM options).

Success criteria suggestions (please modify):
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms on Dedicated for the canonical request profile.
- Throughput: sustain 200 reqs/min with <5% retry rate.
- Functional: integration with your ingestion pipeline, correct prompt templates, and acceptable generation quality on holdout prompts (QA pass rate >= 90% per your reviewers).

Requested next inputs from CureTech to finalize scope:
- Which dataset(s) we should use for the PoC (sample S3 bucket or shared Drive link).
- Whether PHI will be present in Week 0 — if yes, we pause Hosted plan and prioritize Private.
- Primary technical contact for network/peering & entitlements (name + email).

I attached a short PoC runbook and a network requirements template to help the Security team. If that plan sounds reasonable, can we book a 30-min kickoff later this week to confirm stakeholders and schedule?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: RT-Runbook-v1.pdf (PoC tasks & metrics), Network-Reqs-CureTech.xlsx (VPC/peering checklist)

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@curetech.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, CureTech Security <security@curetech.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC deployment fit — post-call recap, deployment-mode questions & proposed trial plan

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Quick responses from the CureTech side: 

We appreciate the two-track approach; pragmatic. A few clarifications: 
- For any workload touching PHI we cannot use a multi-tenant hosted endpoint. Our security and compliance policy requires either Dedicated capacity with customer-dedicated encryption keys or a Private VPC where we control ingress/egress.
- Product prefers Dedicated for performance testing, but Security will only sign off if we can demonstrate KMS/HSM control and network isolation (peering/VPC endpoints).
- Timeline: we need the PoC to complete by end of Q3 (hard constraint). A Dedicated trial in Week 2–5 looks doable if we get the SOC2 summary and a draft of the KMS/keyflow within 3 business days.

Next steps from CureTech:
1) I will share a sanitized sample dataset (S3 link) by EOD tomorrow for the Hosted smoke if we decide to run it without PHI.
2) Security will send a short questionnaire (5–7 items) about encryption and audit logs — please confirm the right contact to receive that.
3) We need an estimate of Dedicated pool sizing/expected cost for a 4-week trial (ballpark).

On ownership: please loop in your Solutions Engineer and Infra contact; I'll add our Security lead (John Park) once we have the SOC2/KMS summary.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Director, Product Integrations
CureTech Labs
priya.singh@curetech.ai | (617) 555-4110

2) Ben (AE) — draft Dedicated 4-week trial estimate in HubSpot and include SKU/sizing notes (Ben by EOD today).
